definitions.explanation: A section on a form, invoice, receipt, or statement where individual items are listed with their specific details such as descriptions, quantities, and amounts.

examples.japanese: {明細欄|めいさいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明細欄|めいさいらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the itemized section of the invoice.

examples.japanese: {明細欄|めいさいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商品名|しょうひんめい}、⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧、⟦{単価|たんか}→単価：05471_tanka⟧、⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The details column must include the product name, quantity, unit price, and amount.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧ (details, itemization) and ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, section). Appears on invoices, pay slips, bank statements, and various official forms. Understanding this term is useful for navigating Japanese financial and administrative documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明細欄|めいさいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the details section
- {明細欄|めいさいらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the details section
- ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}{明細|めいさい}→給与明細：17067_kyuuyomeisai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明細欄|めいさいらん}: the itemized section of a pay slip

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧: details, specifics — the broader term for itemized information
- ⟦{明細書|めいさいしょ}→明細書：13097_meisaisho⟧: detailed statement — a document listing itemized information
- ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: column, section — used in many compounds like ⟦{備考欄|びこうらん}→備考欄：17222_bikouran⟧ (remarks column)
